name: Pera Moss
source_profile:
Pera Moss (NG) — Keeper of the Lantern House

Sister Pera is a healer who operates Thornhollow's modest charitable infirmary, having settled in the town following the War of Broken Banners. She has devoted herself to caring for injured lumbermen, impoverished settlers, and travelers who arrive in need of medical assistance.

A patient and compassionate woman, Pera has earned considerable respect among the laborers of the surrounding timber camps. She maintains a close working relationship with Elias Kearne, whose mutual-aid collections provide much of the infirmary's limited funding. She has also received occasional donations from wealthy merchants and the marquessa's household, although these contributions rarely meet the growing demand for treatment.

Pera is particularly concerned by the frequent injuries suffered in remote logging camps, where workers may remain without medical attention for days before they can be transported into town. She has repeatedly petitioned the municipal administration to require employers to provide basic medical supplies and improved arrangements for evacuating injured laborers.

Her willingness to treat members of the Wilderfolk and wounded travelers of uncertain allegiance has occasionally attracted criticism, particularly when rumors circulate that she has aided outlaws or former rebels. Pera maintains that her obligation is to the injured, regardless of their political loyalties.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 115 (source excerpt; may be partial)
